title: Condensed Copper Recipes
description: Allows crafting of existing copper decorations in all of their different stages, with minimal material loss.
body:
## Jon's Condensed Copper Recipes
> Have you ever left your computer on overnight waiting for copper bars and trapdoors to oxidize? ME TOO. IT TOOK TWO DAYS. Why should you have to wait if you already have the oxidized blocks? 

## This Datapack allows for:

- Crafting copper bars, chains, doors, lightning rods, and trapdoors, at any oxidization stage (and wax state) via stonecutter. 
  - Uses their respective copper block. 
  - You will never gain copper from this process, you will only gain as much as you can craft from the block's nine ingots. The leftover ingot will be a small price to pay for not watching paint dry. 
  - The maximum amount of copper ingots lost is 1, but this only applies to chains, doors, and trapdoors. The rest of the recipes fit into a 1:1 conversion.
  

## Resource Conversion: 
> "Copper Block" means any oxidization stage, as well as waxed/unwaxed

- 1 Copper Block -> 24 Bars
- 1 Copper Block -> 7 Chains (4 nuggets left over/destroyed)
- 1 Copper Block -> 4 Doors (1 ingot destroyed)
- 1 Copper Block -> 3 Lightning Rods
- 1 Copper Block -> 2 Trapdoors (1 ingot destroyed)



- - - 

Copper copper copper it doesn't look like a word anymore
